attributes.name: primary button shape
attributes.definition: Corner/outline shape of the main call-to-action buttons.

values.definition: Other shape or no primary buttons.

attributes.name: primary button fill color
attributes.definition: Hue family of the filled background of the main call-to-action buttons.

values.definition: Buttons use more than one brand color (e.g. orange and navy).
Other color or no filled buttons.

attributes.name: call-to-action label specificity
attributes.definition: Whether CTA button text is specific/action-descriptive or generic.

values.definition: Vague labels such as 'Click Here' or 'Learn More'.
Labels describing the concrete action or outcome.
